title: Omni-Channel RAG Engine
description: A production routing pipeline ingesting real-time webhooks from Meta APIs, with stateful spam protection, localized context parsing via a Supabase vector store, and Postgres schemas for transaction tracking and dynamic human failover.

title: TAC Workflow Backend
description: A PostgreSQL + FastAPI backend simulating and automating Technical Assistance Center workflows, with 3NF schema design, audit logging, and tamper protection triggers, containerized end to end.

title: POSIX C Shell (sate-shell)
description: A custom POSIX-compliant command-line shell written in C. Features dynamic memory allocation, command tokenization, and process management using fork() and execvp() system calls.
